name: mythic-rings
description: Mythic Rings - sorgenti editoriali e pipeline della Prima Edizione

scripts.verify: npm run generate:bestiary && npm run validate && npm test && npm run phase2:check && npm run playtest:plan:check
scripts.build:manual: npm run verify && npm run build:docx && npm run build:html && npm run build:pdf
scripts.build:manual:refresh: npm run verify && npm run build:docx && npm run build:html && npm run build:pdf:refresh
scripts.build:all: npm run clean && npm run build:manual && npm run build:products
scripts.build:all:refresh: npm run clean && npm run build:manual:refresh && npm run build:products
scripts.release:preflight: npm run verify && python3 scripts/release_preflight.py dist/
scripts.release:check: npm run portability:check && npm run build:all:refresh && python3 scripts/release_preflight.py dist/
scripts.release:locked: npm run portability:check && npm run build:all && python3 scripts/release_preflight.py dist/
scripts.watch: nodemon --watch chapters --watch data --ext md,yml --exec "npm run verify && npm run build:docx"
scripts.phase0:check: npm run baseline:check && npm run governance:check && npm run playtest:data:check
scripts.phase1:check: npm run phase0:check && npm run canon:check
scripts.phase2:check: npm run phase1:check && npm run rules:check
